notes.title: Free Citadelum Campaign IV: The Gallic Wars
notes.content:
Ave,

[b]Julius Caesar’s Gallic Wars (58-50 BCE)[/b] remain a pivotal chapter in Roman history, a testament to his military genius and a catalyst for profound societal change in Gaul. More than mere territorial expansion, these campaigns were a brutal yet effective engine of Romanization, laying the groundwork for centuries of Roman dominance north of the Alps.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3480880/Citadelum_Campaign_IV_The_Gallic_Wars/

This period, meticulously documented in Caesar’s own Commentarii de Bello Gallico, which has been our main inspiration for Citadelum new content, offers invaluable insight into Roman military strategy, logistical prowess, and the complex interplay between conquest and cultural assimilation.

[i][b]The Gallic Wars introduces a new biome, the autumn forest[/b][/i], which adds more variety to the game (on top of Peninsula Italica, Africa, Hispania, Snow and Swamps biomes). Enjoy a new region map, more challenging missions and battle scenarios set in Gallia, where you will confront the fearsome leader Vercingetorix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/3d94344d181580df3f7b35707decf84cd255ca12.png[/img]
Beyond the grand battles, the Gallic Wars were a relentless series of smaller conflicts, sieges of fortified oppida, and punitive expeditions. Caesar’s meticulous planning extended to logistics, ensuring a steady supply of provisions for his vast army, often operating deep within enemy territory. The construction of roads and bridges not only facilitated troop movement and communication but also became enduring symbols of Roman power and facilitated future trade and administration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/8c89c8f9c251db094cc5c71fa92e3053487d7e0b.png[/img]
This historical background was perfect for a strategic new campaign, since Citadelum’s core is city building, with exploration, diplomacy (introduced in 2.0 “Julius” update), trade routes and military conflict as additional elements.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2603020/view/511827941447959581
The economic exploitation of Gaul was also a significant aspect of Romanization. The extraction of resources, including timber, minerals, and agricultural produce, enriched Rome and further integrated Gaul into the Roman economic system. Trade flourished along Roman-built roads and waterways, exposing Gauls to Roman goods and practices. This economic integration, while benefiting Rome, also spurred urbanization and the development of new economic opportunities within Gaul, albeit under Roman control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/b9906f6c30e29d251ea18946a9a24d80bbf5bcf8.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy this new free content for Citadelum. And we want to thank you for the positive reviews, the wishlists and game sales. We are already working on upcoming DLCs, improvements and content. Leave us your feedback, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Abylight]join Abylight Page on Steam[/url] to learn about new bundles, discounts, content coming to our games. 
Roma Victrix.

notes.title: Devlog XVIII: AUREUS Game optimization and technical improvements
notes.content:
Ave, citizens of Rome.

With the release of Update 2.0 of Citadelum ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2603020/view/511827941447959581]Devlog XVII: RUBICON Huge gameplay update and new features in Citadelum[/url]) we have dedicated much of the efforts to improve the optimization. At the end of the devlog you will find the complete list of improvements.

[h2]Setup[/h2]
In order to better understand the comparisons and the data obtained, it should be taken into account:
[list]
[*]The settings used for version 1.1 are all maxed out, including Anti-Aliasing, at a resolution of 1920x1080.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/36304a8d6604f441fe7183973f287daa7b38c2ec.png[/img]
[*]The settings used for version 2.0 are all active and in Ultra quality, and here we have made two tests: without Anti-Aliasing and with Anti-Aliasing SSAA. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/c4e5e56c215bd436fa7dd93892325fc5d4d8b16d.jpg[/img]
[*]The test is divided into a total of 12 measurements in different biomes (Italy, Desert and Snow) and spots in the game:
[list]
    [*]Empty (Italy, Desert, Snow): this is an empty map, just as you would start a game.
    [*]Worldmap (Italy, Desert, Snow): view with the zoom out to the maximum of the worldmap.
    [*]Big City (Italy, Desert, Snow): map with a city between 800 and 1000 citizens and all the infrastructure set up.
    [*]Battle (Italy, Desert, Snow): view on the battlefield.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Tests results[/h2]
The test has been performed on 6 different computers, you will find the specifications next to each test. The same game saves have been used for all tests.

[expand type=showmore expanded=false]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/23e33f89579f785a7d8ec124b5e887cdd2eeb8f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/254ab89326c206b2a495a8a8998659b846e7e125.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/e4717f8ae3f42b833ae2d10f78bc01acd314d479.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/6d3bf3dd1f786df155269031de40fe04e49139ee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/216f3143bd7ef2e739fb26c513f4f754c5e567e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/39c83ef6eea30db7912ed763bfc17264eb044770.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

[h2]Graphic comparison[/h2]
Below you can see a comparison of how Citadelum looked and how it looks now, even after having made adjustments to improve optimization.

[expand type=showmore expanded=false]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/1348f43f63a7b9827087a45d5079f39317849f56.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/e42a07101d648518f441543ccccabce130abd848.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*]Level of detail: we have added 2 levels of LODs to environmental elements such as trees and rocks to reduce the polygon load when making an overview of the settlement.
[*]Mesh optimization: we have reduced the number of polygons of objects and characters to free up GPU load without any perceived loss of quality.
[*]Improved loading times: we have optimized the data loading routines to reduce loading times.
[*]Avoid unnecessary memory reservations: we have optimized some processes to reuse already reserved memory to avoid creating garbage that would collapse the collector.
[*]Caching building search processes: We have expanded and improved the caching systems to ensure that costly building search processes are only executed when necessary.
[*]Avoid invalidation of caches: cases where building search caches are invalidated have been cleaned up to make them valid for much longer periods of time.
[*]Revise algorithms to avoid or replace costly processes.
[*]Disable features in materials if they are not used: we have found materials that used shader functionalities that consumed precious GPU cycles without being necessary and we have disabled them.
[*]Avoid data copies in frequently used methods: many methods now receive data by reference, instead of by value, when it is possible and makes sense. This saves unnecessary data copies and potentially frees up a little more CPU.
[*]Avoid running animation events on distant characters: when we know that it is not possible to hear a sound because it is too far away, we now do not even try to play it, thus saving resources.
[/list]

- Mesh optimization: we have reduced the number of polygons of objects and characters to free up GPU load without any perceived loss of quality.
- Improved loading times: we have optimized the data loading routines to reduce loading times.
- Avoid unnecessary memory reservations: we have optimized some processes to reuse already reserved memory to avoid creating garbage that would collapse the collector.
- Caching building search processes: We have expanded and improved the caching systems to ensure that costly building search processes are only executed when necessary.

- Disable features in materials if they are not used: we have found materials that used shader functionalities that consumed precious GPU cycles without being necessary and we have disabled them.

- Avoid data copies in frequently used methods: many methods now receive data by reference, instead of by value, when it is possible and makes sense. This saves unnecessary data copies and potentially frees up a little more CPU.
- Avoid running animation events on distant characters: when we know that it is not possible to hear a sound because it is too far away, we now do not even try to play it, thus saving resources.

notes.title: Devlog XVII: RUBICON Huge gameplay update and new features in Citadelum
notes.content:
Ave, citizens of Rome,

It's been six months since the launch of Citadelum, and from our team, Abylight Barcelona, we want to thank the trust and commitment of all those players who have already built their own Roman empire with us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/b5e23adc86b2b794b4c32014827c8125da507bf2.png[/img]
We have listened to the feedback from the community, and worked hard to offer you a new version of the game; [b]Citadelum 2.0 Julius is a free update[/b] that adds new gameplay options, more depth to the management and construction of the cities and introduces new buildings and mechanics. In addition, this update is accompanied by a technical optimization ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2603020/view/830456433963173676]Devlog XVIII: AUREUS[/url]) that improves the game performance on a wide range of PCs. 

With this crossing of the Rubicon, Citadelum begins a new stage. Our strategy and city building game is even better and bigger, thanks to you. Below you can read the complete list of improvements that have been added in this new version. This is just one more step in the ascent of the game. We continue to work to make it the game that satisfies all players, both strategy fans and those who want to get started in the genre. 

Roma Victrix

[h2]New resources and production buildings[/h2] 
Now you can extract Salt and Clay, and produce Olives, Oil, Clay Bricks, Ceramics, Cheese and Honey in your settlement.

New resources:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/b4b84cff03bab28c5eab31814a6fdd24fe4453da.png[/img]
New production buildings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/a8ae3c43033e1c4037666572636d1dd75ecb66d5.png[/img]
[h2]More complex production chains[/h2] 
Some products such as Bread now need to combine two resources (Wheat and Salt).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/ad70f2e2367a3e109fc2dec08a9b650b021cbbab.jpg[/img]
[h2]Technology improvements[/h2] 
Upgrading the technological level of your city will improve the performance of your buildings and increase the capacity of your warehouses. Thus, when you reach a certain prestige in your city, the possibility of increasing your technological level in exchange for materials will appear in your city's forum. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/0732c122bf4d309cf1dc7bbb9a5bc920a267d521.png[/img]

[h2]Diplomatic relations with cities[/h2] 
The better relationship you have with each city, the better prices you will have to trade and the more troops you will be able to recruit from them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/3922f8daf0309752e3079dbeeb40cfae9de9697e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Secondary missions[/h2] 
Periodically the different councilors of the city will make requests to be fulfilled in a period of time. If they are fulfilled on time you will get benefits but if not... there will be punishments. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/7fccabf0350aab0f99c3d58bacc6b6aad3121d3a.png[/img]

[h2]Trials[/h2] 
Once you have built the Palace of Justice, you will have to make decisions about incidents that affect your city. In each trial you will be presented with two decisions, each one with its consequences (they can be positive and negative). It is important to keep the level of justice high as it influences the town's favor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/5cd19b58af5b7b030daf8020b186780351b248bb.jpg[/img]
[h2]Health system improvements[/h2] 
We have introduced several important changes in the health of the population. Now the health of your town depends on two factors:
[list]
[*]Salubrity: frequently dead people will appear in your settlement, either by natural death or by some violent event such as assassinations or revolts. These dead will remain in the streets lowering the health of your town. To keep the streets clean it is important to build [b]Morgues [/b]that cover all of your inhabited areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/f42c3a72e8d9430f18504a71439b221e93061b3f.png[/img]
[*]Health in the houses: to maintain the health of your houses to the maximum it is important that they are covered by maintenance buildings and medical centers.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/5e476ea7e1c5924579da54e498ac5f279602a57c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Gods improvements.[/h2] 
The relationship with the gods has undergone two important changes based on the feedback you have been reporting:
[list]
[*]Regia and pontiffs: we have added a new building that allows you to automate the festivals of the gods. You can even prioritize the gods you need the most at any given moment.
[*]Sacrifices can no longer be made at any time. You will only be able to make sacrifices when your faith level is very low. Thus we have put an end to the exploit of the pigs.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/ae197c25d30aa032b17d0c2466079e5b2f374094.png[/img]

[h2]Construction of wonders[/h2] 
We have added 3 new wonders that besides being huge and beautiful, will increase the desirability of your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/d344022c1b813a5c6022160437f324074b8eee69.png[/img]

[h2]Simulation mode added for battle confrontations[/h2] 
Now you have the possibility to simulate each battle without the need to play it. As you add troops for the confrontation you will see a bar that will determine the probability of victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/f656bc7de676fbe6f65d18be800cbf5105650336.jpg[/img]
[h2]New achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*]A budding architect: Build your first wonder
[*]Wonderful: Build all 3 wonders in the same game
[*]Divine revelry: Get a pontiff to organize the festivals
[*]Enlightenment and progress: Upgrade the technology level of your city to level 3
[*]Peace in the beyond: Give burial to 50 deceased
[*]Unbreakable alliance: Get an excellent relationship with all cities on the map
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/73cc9b4fba17ca7d7b836a3dfd3b305f48260056.png[/img]
[h2]New languages[/h2] 
Polish and Catalan are added to English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian.

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2] 
[list]
[*]New filter in the construction mode that shows you similar buildings.
[*]With shift + click to assign workers.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/3405fec50058939efa0951ce4411eb4ab335babf.jpg[/img]
[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]We have adjusted how the different factors influencing the people's Favor were calculated, such as the unemployment rate or the crime rate, so that unfair situations do not occur for the player.
[*]We have improved the revolts: now they are more visible, being able to see citizens with torches walking the streets and burning buildings.
[*]We have added new Anti-aliasing options.
[*]We have fixed some terrain chunks where the valid points to build were wrongly configured.
[*]We have updated the tutorials with new explanations of everything included in the update. You can see all of them from the pause menu.
[*]We have fixed a bug that caused that when rebuilding any previously destroyed warehouse it did not keep the filters it had applied. 
To see the changes affecting optimization take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2603020/view/830456433963173676]devlog XVIII: AUREUS[/url].
[/list]

So far, on top of this huge update, in the first six months of Citadelum we have published two additional free DLCs: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358500/Citadelum_Campaign_II_The_Last_Conqueror_of_Britannia/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450060/Citadelum_Campaign_III_The_Lost_Eagles_of_Germania/

Including new, more challenging missions and two new biomes: snow and swamps in new territories. And we are still working on further content for the game, that you will be able to enjoy very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/ddc4420b584779da5cdbee8b6147efdbca4d932d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/ecf7955181e839b4b7ce3a962a1ec0fabe996fe8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/3d94344d181580df3f7b35707decf84cd255ca12.png[/img]

notes.title: Free Citadelum Campaign III: The Lost Eagles of Germania
notes.content:
Hail, citizens of Rome. We are pleased to announce that the free DLC for Citadelum, The Lost Eagles of Germania is now available on Steam (and coming soon on GOG). It is a complete new campaign, in which to experience one of the most delicate moments in the history of Rome. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450060/Citadelum_Campaign_III_The_Lost_Eagles_of_Germania/

For the first time in Citadelum, we move to a new biome, the swamps of Germania, to take on the most challenging missions that have appeared so far: the construction of new cities on the borders of the empire, the battle of Teutoburg, in which the Roman legions suffered a serious defeat, the loss of the eagles that served as a banner... and revenge, along with the troops of General Germanicus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/40b762be6dbb5a0c085791d754f6dad6b65e2101.png[/img]

This additional content, free for all players, includes a series of gameplay improvements and new features:
[list]
[*]New campaign with additional missions, more challenging and deeper.
[*][b]New language, Italian[/b] (translation made by the community).
[*]Added “retry” option if the player ends up in game over.
[*]New objectives for the missions have been added: Obtain the blessing of all gods, defend yourself from a number of attacks, generate a number of denarii through trade routes, generate denarii by selling resources.
[*][b]We have also added time limited missions[/b], these must be completed in a number of days.
[*]Fixed a bug that could freeze the game if a game event coincided with the summoning of a god.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused rebuilding a destroyed structure did not acquire the visual level that corresponded to the prestige of the city.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused that when using the demolish tool on a destroyed building, it returned resources.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/1d8e31952bb56aab18a4e86822d399460ddb07ed.png[/img]
Please, enjoy the new free campaign The Lost Eagles of Germania, consider leaving a positive review on Steam to reach new players and join Abylight Studios on Steam to get the latest news on our games, sales and discounts. 

We want to share the team is already working on a huge gameplay update with new gameplay features and several free DLCs with new content set in historical moments of ancient Rome.

notes.title: CItadelum Prologue from us to you!
notes.content:
Ave, citizens of Citadelum!

Today, we want to speak to you from the heart. Being an indie studio isn't easy. The journey has been tough, full of challenges, but also full of learning. We face a world where big names dominate the industry, and that has pushed us to pour all our passion and effort into Citadelum. Every line of code, concept, model, animation and design idea has been created with dedication and love for what we do. But none of this would be possible without your support. Today, more than ever, we need you to stay with us.

We are thrilled to announce that the prologue of Citadelum is now available on Steam. This free version isn’t just a demo. It’s a window into the future, a first glimpse of your own Roman Empire.

[h3]What’s new in the Prologue?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Battles[/b]: Immerse yourself in our new combat system.
[*] [b]Gods[/b]: Roman deities watch from the pantheon, ready to reward devout citizens or punish rebels.
[*] [b]Improved construction and management[/b]: New buildings and improvements in the labor recruitment system, fire, maintenance and storage system.
[*] [b]Larger Cities[/b]: Now, you can expand your city even further, building a more extensive and thriving metropolis
[*] [b]2 complete missions[/b]: you will be able to fully enjoy the first two missions of the campaign and save your progress for the game's release.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/06b9899d8e382ecf0630d5ced0f5f2f68e596e56.png[/img]

We know we’re small, but every download, review, comment, and word of encouragement drives us to keep going. We’re a studio fighting to make a dream come true, and your participation is crucial in this journey. The prologue is just the beginning. With your support, the future of Citadelum will be glorious!

What’s next?
The prologue is just the beginning of what’s to come. In the full release, you’ll dive deeper into the world of Citadelum with new and complete mechanics such as city defense, more units and bigger combats, complete trade system, enhanced entertainment options, and more complex societal challenges throughout Rome's various historically accurate periods.

There will be 10 levels of prestige, each offering unique upgrades, new functionalities, and higher status. Additionally, a Sandbox Mode will be available, allowing you to explore the game without restrictions, infinitely expanding replayability. We’re also excited to introduce a map and missions editor, mod support, and numerous UI improvements, feedback integration, and quality-of-life enhancements.

Download the prologue on Steam. Wishlist Citadelum and leave us a review. Your feedback is gold to us.

See you in Citadelum, citizens! May the gods be kind to you. From Abylight dev team to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/75c3104ee83931b5b804e692125c6a94cbbae43f.png[/img]

notes.title: City defense and battles ready in Citadelum!
notes.content:
Ave, Romans! 

Welcome to our latest update on the progress of Citadelum. Our team has been hard at work, and we're excited to share the progress we've made. First, let’s review some of the core functionalities that are now complete:

[list]
[*][b] Imperium  Building[/b]: Players can build and expand your cities from the ground up.
[*] [b]Resource Gathering & Refinement[/b]: You can gather and refine various resources essential for your city’s development and survival.
[*] [b]Trade with Different Villages[/b]: Trade with different civilizations is operational, giving you access to a range of goods and strategic alliances.
[*][b] World Exploration[/b]: The world is open for exploration, revealing new territories, resources, and opportunities.
[*] [b]Punishments and blessings[/b]: Your worship of the gods is very important for the prosperous development of your city, you must maintain their approval or face fatal consequences.
[/list]

At the moment, we are consolidating these core mechanics and entering an exciting phase of expansion and content refinement. We have several thrilling updates to share with you, introducing new systems and expanding existing ones to enhance your experience in Citadelum.

[h3]City Defense System[/h3]

The City Defense System is now in development, allowing you to fortify your cities with walls, towers, and other defenses against invasions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/a6dc4de7a97d1b9d964544dddae5fe77197c7ab7.png[/img]
This system will add a new layer of strategic depth, requiring careful planning and resource management to ensure your city can withstand external threats.

[h3]Army Battles[/h3]

We're introducing large-scale battles where you can train and command legions. These battles will occur near your city and on distant battlefields, requiring strategic management of formations, unit types, and tactics for victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/e23276af2fa8b7ff2b3a7523bd0bd6dde7bc4fd4.png[/img]

[h3]Gladiator Fights & Circus Races[/h3]

Enhance your city’s entertainment with gladiator fights and chariot races. Build arenas, train gladiators, and host thrilling events to boost prestige and experience the excitement of the Circus Maximus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/03c3e07d0fc45a3eba5a97da605bf80dde8d156e.png[/img]

[h3]Campaigns[/h3]

Our team is also working on a series of campaigns that will bring rich narratives and varied challenges to the game. These campaigns will immerse you in the world of Citadelum with compelling storylines and strategic missions.

[h3]Map Editor[/h3]

We are developing a map editor that will allow you to create and customize your own game maps. This tool will give you the freedom to design unique scenarios and share your creations with the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/eceafb6e1e0f4d2f620c815e7b95baaccb586161.png[/img]

[h3]Mod Support[/h3]

To further enhance player creativity, we're adding support for mods. This will enable you to modify game content, introduce new features, and tailor your Citadelum experience to your preferences.

See you in Citadelum, Citizens!

notes.title: Next Fest and the Future
notes.content:
Welcome to the Citadelum Demo at Steam Next Fest:
We are thrilled to share with you the first demo of Citadelum which Includes two missions that will allow you to explore several features of this city builder set in ancient Rome. Each mission has its own map and tasks to complete, giving you the freedom to build and customize the city to your liking.

[h3]Mission 1: Establish and Learn to Manage a Roman City[/h3]

You will get to know the different types of citizens and Roman industries. Expand your settlement and establish the first trade route to obtain crucial materials for Rome.

[h3]Mission 2: Manage More Complex Resources[/h3]

Improve your population’s housing and build amenities for the inhabitants. Get to know the gods, hold festivals and sacrifices. Discover the legions, though combat will not be present in the demo. This mission is more challenging and will give you an idea of the strategic depth of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/64ba7a9820d9e64d22da4662ae53da92522e4230.png[/img]
[h3]Balance and Prosperity[/h3]

Management is crucial in Citadelum. Plebeians are essential for services and industry, but you will need patricians to sustain the economy and pay salaries through their taxes.

It is vital to manage your economy well for your city to prosper. You don't want to find yourself in a bankruptcy situation, so ensuring economic balance is fundamental. Although you have the backing of Rome, which will help you twice, on the third time, they will show no mercy and take your possessions.

The happiness of the population will depend on various factors such as employment, housing, health, religious festivities, entertainment, salaries, and taxes. Maintaining a balance in these aspects will be crucial, or you will face disturbances, thefts, and even murders. As a leader, it is your priority to maintain social peace.

[h3]Religion[/h3]

Ascend to the pantheon to seek the help of one of the six gods. If you have satisfied their desires with temples and prayers, they will appear in person at your camp to reward your devotion. However, beware of the rivalries among the gods. Unconditional faith in one can lead to punishment from another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/0629da8b59d2cd121aa72d8c5714bebd117c2bd3.png[/img]

[h3]Vital Resources and Needs[/h3]

Resource management and different zones of your city are vital parts of your role as a leader. Ensure that there are enough materials to meet your citizens' needs. You can upgrade their homes up to six levels by constructing various amenities such as baths, schools, taverns, and theaters. Don’t overlook decorating the living areas to enhance their desirability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/d1e4361b3f1ec8b273027d734143948bc8fcaf71.png[/img]

[h3]The Future of Citadelum[/h3]

The demo is just a small glimpse of what is to come. In the full release, you will enjoy new complete mechanics such as religion, relics, defending your city against enemy attacks, legions and combat, more entertainment solutions, and greater societal issues throughout the campaign during various historical points of Rome.

There will be 10 levels of prestige, each with upgrades, new functionalities, and higher status. We will also have a Sandbox Mode, allowing you to enjoy the game without restrictions, expanding replayability infinitely. We will include a map editor, mod support, and tons of UI improvements, feedback, and quality of life enhancements.

[h3]Help Us Improve[/h3]

We want you to be part of this journey. Add Citadelum to your wishlist, share your creations on social media, join our discord server, and leave us your comments. Your support and feedback are essential to us. https://discord.gg/ThX6v3rrBb

Take care and see you in Citadelum, Romans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/7952fa0b3e5dce548598394d7141b1b42e3b1efa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Refining resources, materials and storage in Citadelum!
notes.content:
The glory of Rome depends on production, organization and trade of resources, some elements we are implementing in Citadelum. From the extraction of resources to their refinement, and turning them into valuable materials, we challenged ourselves to achieve a perfect balance that will satisfy our players.

When considering the needs of our villagers and military for the development of our city, we have divided the resources into the following 3 groups

[h3]Food: Nutrition and Happiness[/h3]

Food is the cornerstone of our city sustenance. It nourishes and brings happiness to the citizens. As we have already discussed in previous devlogs, we will unlock new resources and needs of our villagers through our progression, starting with wheat and ending with grape orchards that we will need for making wine.

[h3]Construction: Foundations of Strength[/h3]

Starting from stone, iron and wood, natural resources we will find close to our settlement, we will be able to transform them in order to obtain materials such as planks or bricks, essential for the creation of buildings and improvements to our city. As each natural resource has a specific location, the player must have a strategy when it comes to the urban planning of his city and the industrial zones.

[h3]Armament: Protection and Power [/h3]

Military resources are a different category in Citadelum. Iron and flax, that can  be transformed into cloth, will offer us the tools to create both weapons and armor for our fearsome legions. These resources not only sustain us for defense and support the economy but also pave the way for the prosperity and expansion of our city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/c1e72ee2d98298cb2bb373336bcfbbf68f778243.png[/img]

[h2]Product Refinement[/h2]

At the heart of Citadelum lies the essence of innovation, where raw materials are refined into valuable goods. Here, we showcase the process by which simple resources are transformed into coveted goods that drive the prosperity of our Roman city.

[h3]Food Goods[/h3]

[b]Bakery[/b]
The bakery is where the sustenance of our population is crafted. Here, wheat is transformed into fragrant loaves of bread that satiate hunger and provide energy to our citizens. Beyond nourishing our people, the bakery promotes happiness and community well-being.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/466db200b847f444089a092f9bf9896deae51756.png[/img]

[b]Butchery[/b]
The butchery is an essential establishment in our community, where fresh meat is carefully prepared for human consumption. Here, expert butchers select the finest cuts of meat. In addition to providing nutritious sustenance, processed meat is one of the most important and valued foods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/fcf825f48889f4525430fac93c7a1854197c9840.png[/img]

[b]Fishmonger[/b]
The fishmonger is a vital enclave in our coastal city. Fishmongers transform fish into fish portions. They handle and prepare fish for sale. Prepared fish is a highly coveted food for the inhabitants of Citadelum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/e8a8c2c241284c7ebdca96f654ed0f3c83207e70.png[/img]

[b]Wine maker[/b]
Here, spirits are produced to uplift the hearts and celebrations of our city. Using traditional methods and the finest ingredients, distillers create aromatic wines that will be enjoyed at festivities and banquets. The workers at the distillery handle the grapes with skill, allowing for the creation of wines that are authentic masterpieces under their philosophy: “In Vino Veritas”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/554aa3499467c61df19edcd1ff27f2c7c7fecb01.png[/img]

[h3]Raw Goods[/h3]

[b]Sawmill[/b]
The sawmill is a pivotal point in the transformation of raw timber into lumber. A refined resource that enhances the quality of constructions and furniture. It also maximizes the use of timber by converting it into planks, increasing its value as a finished product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/d98f56e3439f36c6729413b972f40c47e4c81ff7.png[/img]

[b]Stonecutter[/b]
The stonecutter is where raw stone is refined into blocks for construction. These blocks allow for the construction of buildings of greater significance and quality. Additionally, it optimizes the use of stone by converting it into blocks, which gain higher value as a final product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/5cd5b3f718d045e44a60240aa74079961f7c874c.png[/img]

[b]Loom[/b]
The loom is the specialized workshop where threads are meticulously woven to create fabrics of exceptional quality. Here, skilled artisans use linen to produce a wide range of textiles. Their work is based on producing high-quality clothing and other textile products, which will be valued by the population.

[b]Furniture Workshop[/b]
In the furniture workshop, furnishings that adorn and beautify our homes and buildings are constructed. Expert carpenters work with wooden planks with skill and precision, creating furniture of high quality and durability that will be appreciated by the highest level of the population.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/a8af3521b4a4158eecc42a549753fb45e3c221a3.png[/img]

[h3]Military Goods[/h3]

[b]Armor Workshop[/b]
In the armor workshop, skilled craftsmen shape and assemble metal pieces to create armor. During their creation, cloth and iron are used as primary materials. These armors provide protection to our soldiers during combat. 

There will also be one type of forge for each type of weapon needed in the legion, being [b]Swordsmith, Bow workshop and Shield workshop.[/b]

The blacksmith forge in the workshop where finely crafted high-quality weapons are made, using wood and iron in their crafting. This establishment is essential for equipping our soldiers with the best weapons, ensuring their effectiveness on the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/41da1729de688557effa7022ca68827172a32196.png[/img]

[h2]Storage[/h2]

In Citadelum, storage and trade hold great importance. They can drive the economy forward, ensuring that resources flow smoothly throughout the city. For this, certain functions are required, which are divided into 3 buildings:

[b]Granary[/b]
The granary is essential in our food supply chain, serving as a central storage point for our agricultural products. Here, freshly harvested crops are preserved, ensuring their freshness and safety until distribution and consumption.

The task of its workers is to make the granary the epicenter of food distribution and movement throughout the base, ensuring accessibility for all.

[b]Warehouse[/b]
The warehouse plays a crucial role in our city as a central storage and distribution point for a wide variety of products and materials. Here, goods are securely stored and efficiently managed for use in construction, manufacturing, and consumption.

Its function is essential to maintain an uninterrupted flow of resources and products in our economy, ensuring a constant and timely supply.

[b]Armory[/b]
The armory plays a fundamental role as a strategic center for the storage and distribution of weapons and military equipment in our city. Here, weapons and armor that will equip our troops for defense and combat are safeguarded and maintained.

Its function is essential to keep our military force ready and prepared for any military action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/7f785ef875ffed56e76806a16a88fa37b1b5d13b.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Considerations[/h2]

[b]Chain Expansion [/b]
Unlock new buildings to expand and enhance production chains. As you unlock these, you'll have more options to refine production lines.

[b]Supply Chain Optimization[/b] 
Place storage facilities near production centers for maximum efficiency. Also, position buildings requiring external resources, such as a sawmill needing wood, near storage facilities.

[b]Trade goods[/b] 
Commerce allows you to import and export goods.This provides flexibility in your base by prioritizing certain materials for sale, fostering the economy, expanding your economic reach, taking advantage of the price fluctuation depending on supply and demand and ensuring you always have access to any resource you need. Although this is a topic we will discuss in detail in a future devlog.

With all this information, here is a chart showing the complete production chain that will be available at Citadelum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838290/0d7a0fa58024be0b9b679d2c2239716b4b5d5cdf.png[/img]

Master all these systems to turn your settlement into a true urbe. With a solid production and trade system, the glory of Citadelum awaits you!
